title: RichAds Telegram SSP bare JSON array with no id field and a bid_price/notification_url naming

source.name: RichAds Telegram SSP API — bare JSON array response contract
source.notes: All source records are retained in assets/sources.json by reference.sourceIds.

modifications: All creative text and URLs independently authored; no live subscriber, publisher, or SSP token.

The documented shape has no id/tId field at all, prices are keyed bid_price (not cpc/price), and the win-notify pixel is keyed notification_url (not icon_url/icon/nurl) — this fixture preserves that exact field-name set rather than substituting Core's generic push aliases.
image_preload is carried through unmodified even though nothing in Core consumes it; it is part of the documented wire shape, not padding.

No POST body / request side is modeled: RichAds' request is a flat snake_case POST body (ip, user_agent, publisher_id, widget_id, telegram_id, bid_floor, ...), an entirely different field set from any registered URL-request decoder, so this case stays response-only rather than inventing a request the vendor's own docs do not describe as a GET/URL contract.
provenance.sanitized: No real Telegram user, publisher, or SSP identifiers. All URLs use reserved .test hostnames and are not intended to be fetched.

specNotes: RichAds documents this response as a bare JSON array of {title, description, image, image_preload, notification_url, link, bid_price} — no oRTB envelope, no id/tId field, and price/win-notify keyed differently from every other push vendor in this corpus (sources-vendor map §2a).

detectFeedFormat correctly tags this array push (RichAds happens to use the bare `image`/`link`/`title` keys detectFeedFormat's hasImage/hasClick/hasTitle test recognizes) — the deviation recorded here is scoped to the field-level false positives only, not format detection.

Desired capability per the vendor's own documented contract: a complete RichAds material validates with no id-required or price-required error, and no nurl-missing warning, because notification_url already fills the win-notify role by a different name. Existing product acceptance is not the validity oracle.

Wrapping this identical object in a bare array (rather than posting it as a single object) is what triggers the deviation: validateFeedResponse dispatches ANY array unconditionally to the push-material validator (rules-feed.js), bypassing the detectSingleBidShape discriminator that would otherwise recognize notification_url/bid_price as the bid-price vendor shape (validateBidPriceFeed) — see knownGap DEF-161.
notes: Core observations in the source archive were deliberately excluded from expectations. Protocol metadata may describe a vendor-specific 2.x carrier; it does not claim a normative minor-version inference.
